fields.title: 📖 Whoever Points to Good Receives a Share of the Reward
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said or transmitted:

> ***“Whoever points to something good receives the same reward as the one who does it.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tarbiyyah also takes place through pointing and reminder. A single good word can open doors to ongoing reward.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim; Überlieferung von Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī.
